subject.title: [infra] readResponseBodySnippet non-streaming fallback reads entire response without size bound

question: Which open fixing PR should be treated as the canonical landing path for the no-reader response-body bound, and should the other duplicate path be closed after that choice?
rationale: The issue is valid and still present on main, but there are two open closing PRs with overlapping fallback semantics and at least one branch currently needs maintainer handling before merge.

options.title: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101270 as canonical
options.body: Treat the proof-positive fail-closed branch as the main fix path, resolve its current base conflict, and close or supersede the duplicate PR after the chosen fix lands.

options.title: Switch to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101313
options.body: Use the sibling branch only if maintainers prefer its final no-reader behavior and proof package over the current canonical candidate.

options.title: Reject both and request a fresh patch
options.body: Close both open fix PRs only if maintainers decide neither branch is the desired compatibility shape for the SDK-visible helper.

recommendation.title: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101270 as canonical
recommendation.body: Treat the proof-positive fail-closed branch as the main fix path, resolve its current base conflict, and close or supersede the duplicate PR after the chosen fix lands.
